name: Mage-Bench
description: Mage-Bench is a benchmark in which large language models play Magic: The Gathering against each other through a fork of the XMage rules engine. LLMs make decisions about mulligans, spells, combat, and politics while the engine enforces the full complexity of Magic's rules across formats including Commander, Standard, Modern, and Legacy. Single-game decisions and multi-game sequential play test strategic and tactical reasoning over long horizons in a card-based, mostly text-encoded game state with 28,000+ unique cards.
evaluation_method: win rate across LLM-vs-LLM matches across formats and seat counts; seasonal championship
general_score_metric: match win rate (per format / per matchup)
typical_sota_score: Season 1 Champion: Gemini 3 Pro (medium); first basically successful full 4-LLM Commander game recorded 2026-02-10
reputation: A growing community benchmark referenced by Epoch AI as an example of a card-game benchmark with large remaining headroom for LLM strategic reasoning; Season 1 Champion was Gemini 3 Pro (medium).
notes: Built on XMage with full rules enforcement for 28,000+ cards across Commander, Standard, Modern, and Legacy. Supports 1v1 and multiplayer Commander. Open-source; runs locally with video recording. Tests long-horizon strategic and tactical reasoning under partial information without significant multimodal demands.
